findings.highlight: her voice
findings.evidenceJa: 泣き叫ぶような桜の声
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s voice, almost a sobbing scream
findings.explanation: The intensity of Sakura’s intervention disappears.

findings.highlight: Say it again. I couldn’t hear you really well.
findings.evidenceJa: 桜はどうしたい？　ここに残るか、間桐家に帰るか
findings.governingReading: what does Sakura want: to remain here or return to the Matou house
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces Shinji’s coercively staged choice with an invented demand that Sakura repeat herself.

findings.highlight: I’ll do anything you say
findings.evidenceJa: 言う事をきくから
findings.governingReading: she will obey what he says
findings.explanation: The mature branch broadens Sakura’s submission into an unlimited promise to do anything.

findings.highlight: you’re going to do anything I say
findings.evidenceJa: 僕の言う事を聞くんだな
findings.governingReading: she will obey him
findings.explanation: The mature branch again intensifies extracted obedience into an unlimited “anything.”

findings.highlight: If you’re so determined
findings.evidenceJa: そこまで言われちゃ
findings.governingReading: if she goes so far as to say that much
findings.explanation: Shinji’s response to the extent of Sakura’s submission becomes praise for independent determination.

findings.highlight: A big brother has to respect his sister’s wishes
findings.evidenceJa: ボクは寛大な兄貴だからね
findings.governingReading: he is a magnanimous older brother, he claims
findings.explanation: The mature branch deletes Shinji’s smug self-characterization and converts it into a general rule for brothers.

findings.highlight: That was just a joke
findings.evidenceJa: 場の雰囲気に合わせたジョーク
findings.governingReading: a joke fitted to the mood of the scene
findings.explanation: Shinji’s grotesque claim that his conduct matched the atmosphere disappears.

findings.highlight: don’t forget what you just said, Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 気が向いたらいつでも帰ってきていいんだぞ
findings.governingReading: Sakura may come home whenever she feels like it
findings.explanation: The mature branch replaces Shinji’s unsettling performance of permission with an explicit reminder of her coerced promise.

findings.highlight: gives the kitchen an awkward atmosphere
findings.evidenceJa: 台所は、ひどく気まずい
findings.governingReading: the kitchen itself is painfully awkward
findings.explanation: The English turns the characters’ shared condition into something the chopping sound creates.

findings.highlight: Ohyeah.
findings.evidenceJa: ぁああ、そうだな
findings.governingReading: Ah—yeah, that sounds right
findings.explanation: The fused interjection again produces malformed English and loses Shirou’s fluster.

findings.highlight: Sakura moves briskly, as if nothing happened
findings.evidenceJa: 手伝いをしてくれる
findings.governingReading: Sakura briskly helps him as if nothing happened
findings.explanation: Her continued contribution to the shared dinner work disappears.

findings.highlight: Sakura’s the one who got hurt.
findings.evidenceJa: まいっているのは桜の方だ
findings.governingReading: Sakura is the one who is distressed and worn down
findings.explanation: The mature branch changes emotional exhaustion into a completed physical injury, carrying forward the unsupported assault.

findings.highlight: If she’s going to smile
findings.evidenceJa: たとえ強がりでも笑顔でいるのなら
findings.governingReading: even if the smile is only a brave front
findings.explanation: The strained, defensive nature of Sakura’s smile disappears.

findings.highlight: The sound of a bowl breaking
findings.evidenceJa: 茶碗の落ちる音
findings.governingReading: the sound of the rice bowl falling
findings.explanation: The sound is assigned to breakage rather than the fall that first draws Shirou’s attention.

findings.highlight: Ow
findings.evidenceJa: 熱っ
findings.governingReading: Hot!
findings.explanation: Shirou’s realization of Sakura’s fever becomes a cry of being hurt.

findings.highlight: Hey, Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: しっかりしろ桜
findings.governingReading: hold on and stay with him, Sakura
findings.explanation: Shirou’s urgent plea for responsiveness disappears.

findings.highlight: she tries her best
findings.evidenceJa: ぼんやりとした意識のまま、せいいっぱい気を張って
findings.governingReading: despite hazy consciousness, she strains with all her strength to remain alert
findings.explanation: Nearly the entire mechanism of Sakura’s effort to speak coherently is omitted.

findings.highlight: take you to bed and have you rest
findings.evidenceJa: いますぐベッドに放り込んで寝かしつける
findings.governingReading: he will put her straight into bed and make sure she sleeps
findings.explanation: The comic force and active caretaking are softened.

findings.highlight: it doesn’t seem all that bad
findings.evidenceJa: 熱自体はそう上がってはいなさそうだ
findings.governingReading: the fever itself does not appear to have risen very much
findings.explanation: A limited change assessment becomes a broad judgment of severity.

findings.highlight: her room
findings.evidenceJa: 客間
findings.governingReading: the guest room
findings.explanation: The room’s status in the Emiya household is changed into Sakura’s possessive room.

findings.highlight: it’s time to start patrolling the area
findings.evidenceJa: 巡回の支度を始める時間
findings.governingReading: it is time to begin preparing for patrol
findings.explanation: Preparation becomes immediate commencement of the patrol.

findings.highlight: she must be busy tonight
findings.evidenceJa: 何か用事があったのか顔を出さなかった
findings.governingReading: perhaps because she had some errand, Taiga did not show her face
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative explanation becomes a confident and more general claim about Taiga’s evening.
